svg.text: A framework to structure, compile and distribute decision records so that AI agents and humans can reliably find and use them
Each decision record decomposes into specialized document types
Rules, guardrails, core decisions. The source of truth.
Captured as ADR / BDR / EDR policy documents.
Research — Why the decision was made
Problem context, constraints, findings, option tradeoffs.
One research may inform multiple downstream policies.
Step-by-step procedural guides for humans or AI agents.
Synthetic texts combining multiple policies and skills.
Never replace policies as source of truth.
Plans — When / How to roll out
Ephemeral execution docs. Deleted after implementation.
Lasting outputs become Policies, Skills, or Articles.
Scopes organize decision ownership. Scopes listed later in root index.md override earlier ones.
Meta-governance: authoring standards, scope-type definitions. No consumable policies.
Standards, regulations, reference models. Read-only adoptable material.
Live services and infrastructure teams can consume. Documents operational capabilities.
Business areas, products, teams. General-purpose scopes. Default type.
Workspace-local overrides. Never distributed. Highest precedence within workspace.
define rules for ALL scopes of a
1. Scope-type standards → 2. follows: standards → 3. Local meta-policies (all subordinate to _core structural rules)
When absent from workspace: companion scope is READ-ONLY. Governed scope declares follows: in its index.md.
Teams build their own XDRS packages
